# Shared code inventory

**Generated by `bun run inventory`. Do not edit by hand.**

Read this before creating a component. If something here fits, use it; if it
nearly fits, extend it in its package rather than copying it into an app.

## @ludika/mobile-ui

Expo / React Native. HeroUI Native + Uniwind. Used by ludika-client and ludika-driver.

#### Components

Import from the package root. Subpath imports also work: `@ludika/mobile-ui/components/<file>`.

| --- | --- | --- |
| `Container` | `container.tsx` | `@ludika/mobile-ui` |
| `SignIn`, `SignInProps` | `sign-in.tsx` | `@ludika/mobile-ui` |
| `SignUp`, `SignUpProps` | `sign-up.tsx` | `@ludika/mobile-ui` |
| `ThemeToggle` | `theme-toggle.tsx` | `@ludika/mobile-ui` |

## App-local components

Not shared API. Anything here that a second app would want belongs in a
package instead - see the promotion rule in `AGENTS.md`.

- `apps/ludika-client/components/`: `order-draft-context.tsx`, `order-step.tsx`
- `apps/web/src/components/`: `header.tsx`, `loader.tsx`, `mode-toggle.tsx`, `providers.tsx`, `sign-in-form.tsx`, `sign-up-form.tsx`, `theme-provider.tsx`, `user-menu.tsx`
